extracted text: The paper discusses AA2219 aluminum alloy in T87 and T851 temper conditions. The T87 temper condition involves solution treatment at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + 7% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours. The T851 temper condition involves solution treatment at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + stress relieved by 3% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours.
